info.name: Atlassian Admin Account Pullrequests - Commit Statuses API
Atlassian List Commit Statuses For A Pull Request

params.name: pull_request_id
params.description: The id of the pull request.

params.name: repo_slug
params.description:
This can either be the repository slug or the UUID of the repository,
surrounded by curly-braces, for example: `{repository UUID}`.

params.name: workspace
params.description:
This can either be the workspace ID (slug) or the workspace UUID
surrounded by curly-braces, for example: `{workspace UUID}`.

params.name: q
params.description:
Query string to narrow down the response as per
[filtering and sorting](/cloud/bitbucket/rest/intro/#filtering).

params.name: sort
params.description:
Field by which the results should be sorted as per
[filtering and sorting](/cloud/bitbucket/rest/intro/#filtering).
Defaults to `created_on`.

items.docs:
Returns all statuses (e.g. build results) for the given pull
request.
